100001.scheme_name: Tamil Nadu Government Scholarship for Differently Abled Students
100001.details: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to differently abled students to pursue higher education in Tamil Nadu
100001.benefits: Up to Rs. 1000 per month for UG and PG students
100001.eligibility: Disability > 40%, OBC category, UG/PG students, Family income < 200000 per annum from all sources, Domicile of Tamil Nadu
100001.application: Apply online through the official website of the Tamil Nadu Government at https://www.tn.gov.in/, Fill the application form, Upload required documents, Submit the application
100001.documents: Disability certificate, Income certificate, Caste certificate, ID proof, Bank account details, Domicile certificate
100001.tags: Disability, Scholarship, OBC, UG, PG, Tamil Nadu
